title: How many male customers who are living in North Bohemia have average salary
question: How many male customers who are living in North Bohemia have average salary greater than 8000?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id)
FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN district_info AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
INNER JOIN district_numeric AS T3 ON T1.district_id = T3.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'M'
  AND T2.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND T3.A11 > 8000

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN district_info d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND d.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
GROUP BY c.client_id
HAVING AVG(t.amount) > 8000
)
